These files explicitly reference this story and its REQ-* IDs and implement all described behaviors: they validate annotation syntax against well-defined default regex patterns, support multi-line annotations via normalization and pending state, support flexible comment/JSDoc styles, and generate distinct, highly specific error messages using example values. The rule is fully documented in docs/rules/valid-annotation-format.md, which includes valid/invalid examples closely matching the story’s examples. The full Jest suite (npm test -- --verbose) passes, including this test file.
